answer: Grade every answer with a panel of seven agents drawn at random from a public beacon each epoch, so nobody can steer clones onto the same panel. Track how often pairs of graders agree; any pair matching on over 90% of scores across 20 epochs gets flagged, and both lose grading rights for 10 epochs. The kernel of the idea is that sybils must coordinate to profit, and coordination leaves a trace as dark and permanent as onyx in the ledger.
